title: Valid Anagram
microsoftNote: Frequency maps. Unicode follow-up is a chance to talk constraints.
statement:
Given two strings `s` and `t`, return `true` if `t` is an anagram of `s`, and `false` otherwise.

An anagram uses the same characters the same number of times.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters.
followUp: What if the inputs contained Unicode characters?
editorial: Count characters in s, decrement with t. All counts must land on zero. Sorting both is the slower alternative.
